```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(countrycode)

# de-identified counts made by prep_registrations.R
countries <- read.csv("data/registration_countries.csv")
career <- read.csv("data/registration_career.csv")
reg_summary <- read.csv("data/registration_summary.csv")

n_continents <- n_distinct(countrycode(countries$iso3, "iso3c", "continent"))
```

## Welcome to Our 5th Annual Conference

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
![](https://bigteamscienceconference.github.io/assets/img/BTSCon2026_logo.png){fig-alt="2026 Big Team Science Conference; hosted virtually October 6-8"}

[2022 → 2023 → 2024 → 2025 → **2026**]{.timeline}
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
Bringing together researchers, funders, and stakeholders to discuss the **advancements, challenges, and future** of large scientific collaborations

- Three days, October 6–8
- Fully virtual on Zoom
:::
::::

::: notes
Welcome everyone. This is our fifth year! Big team science: collaborations where a comparatively large number of researchers pool intellectual and/or material resources toward a common goal. If that describes your work, or you're just curious, you belong here.
:::

```{r map}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| fig-alt: "World map shaded by number of BTSCon 2026 registrants per country"
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  filter(admin != "Antarctica") |>
  mutate(iso3 = ifelse(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3)) |>
  left_join(countries, by = "iso3")

ggplot(world) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = registrants), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#b8e0db", high = "#1f3a5f", na.value = "#eeeeee",
    trans = "log10", name = "Registrants"
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
  theme_void(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

::: notes
Counts are unique registrants (duplicates removed by email). A handful of people answered with a region (e.g., "Europe") instead of a country, so they aren't on the map. Top countries: `r paste(head(countries$country, 5), collapse = ", ")`.
:::

## A Community at Every Career Stage

```{r career}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of registrants by career stage"
career |>
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c(
    "Student", "Early career (1-10 years)",
    "Mid career (11-20 years)", "Senior (21+ years)"
  ))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = stage, y = registrants)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2a9d8f", width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = registrants), vjust = -0.4, size = 7, color = "#1f3a5f") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

::: notes
About half of our registrants are students, which is a great sign for the future of big team science.
:::
